evidence_quotes.agenda: No quid pro quo framing or agenda question — went straight into confirming the move details from the online request.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer pushed back twice that the move 'is not gonna take that long' and later called the price 'high' as the call ended — the rep repeated the same range/policy each time rather than probing what was driving the skepticism, scored shallow.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: 'we're time based so you only pay for the actual time' + 'if you move like 2.5 or 3 hours, you only pay for that' — explicit beats-it-pay-less confirmation; no rate-lock/100k line, no self-prep tip, no fairness check.

top_strength: Gave a clear, well-personalized estimate range accounting for the floor difference (2nd floor to 4th floor) between the two units.
coaching_note: When the customer twice pushed back that the estimate felt too long/expensive, the rep repeated the same range instead of asking what was driving the skepticism or reassuring with specifics — a missed chance to build confidence before the call ended on 'that's high.'
